definition.text: Rumour. (1.) A Reubenite (1 Chr. 5:8). (2.) A Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:13). (3.) One who stood by Ezra when he read the law (Neh. 8:4). (4.) A town in the south of Judah (Josh. 15:26); the same as Sheba (ver. 5).

lemmas.gloss: Shema, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Isra
Rekem, the name of a place in Palestine, also of a Midia
Joel, the name of twelve Israelites
